desc: Split the pattern into prefix, middle, and suffix strings based on the two `*` characters.
Handle edge cases where prefix or suffix is empty, simplifying the search logic.
Precompute or efficiently find all starting/ending indices of the prefix and suffix in `s`.
Iterate through possible positions of the prefix and suffix, ensuring they don't overlap improperly.
For each valid prefix-suffix pair, check if the middle part exists in the substring between them.
Calculate the length of the matching substring for valid cases and return the minimum length, or -1 if none found.
